title: fix(lint)!: os build and the object save door refuse a validations[] rule whose predicate reads parent
body:
Closes #24957
Clause-②: no (narrowing: a `validations[]` rule that reads `parent` is refused at `os build` and the object save door; it ships now under the amended 「甲」, #6015 `6303865025`)

## What changes

A `validations[]` rule's predicates (a `script` / `cross_field` rule's `condition`, a `conditional` rule's `when`, and the same slots on the rules nested in its `then` / `otherwise`) are evaluated by ObjectQL in `ruleScope(record, previous)`, which binds no `parent`. Such a predicate faults (`Unknown variable: parent`) on every write it judges and fails closed. The 18.x verdict shipped at `warning` (PR #24763, `8cfe1f94cb`). This PR ships the refusal half, re-timed to 18.x as a BREAKING minor.

- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`: `validationRuleParentIssue`'s finding is pushed at `error` instead of `warning`. The message drops "This is a warning today; `os build` and the object save door will refuse it from 19.0." The docblock's "Why a warning, and when it becomes a refusal" section becomes "Why an error". The location, rule id, prescription and the field-rule controls are unchanged.
- The object save door runs the same pass (`runStackExpressionPasses`), so the door's verdict moves from advisory to error with no door code change. A publish-mode object save now answers `422 INVALID_METADATA`.
- Changeset `.changeset/24957-validation-rule-parent-error.md`: `@objectstack/lint` `minor`, BREAKING banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing …)`, ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` (shape of the `bb4f5cc005` precedent).

## The gate on #24684 (withdrawal condition)

#24684 closed `completed` through PR #24731 (`576d0f3733`). It landed route B: three lifecycle hooks on `showcase_invoice_line`. It made no objectql, lint or spec change. On `origin/main` `3b3830ca22`, `checkPredicate` / `checkConditional` still call `ruleScope(record, previous)` (`rule-validator.ts` lines 4511 / 4695), and `ruleScope` adds no `parent`. So `parent` is still unbound for `validations[]`, and the withdrawal condition does not hold.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.validation-rule-parent.test.ts`: every severity assertion now reads `error`. `os validate` / `os build` carry the finding as their only error. The door finding is in `errors`, not `advisories`, and the door/build parity is unchanged. New: the message promises no later release, and an `active: false` rule or an update-only rule is refused too (the rule is judged as written). Controls unchanged: `parent` on a field's own `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen`, `record` / `previous` reads, `record.parent_code`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`, new block `(#24957)` through the real `saveMetaItem`: (a) an active save is refused `422 INVALID_METADATA` with the build's located finding, and nothing lands; (b) a draft save still succeeds, and its promotion and a package draft publish are refused; (c) control: `parent` on `readonlyWhen`, and a `record` rule, save and land.
- Reverse verification, through `dist/`: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put the severity back to `warning` with a marker, then rebuilt lint. `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 4 built files. The door block went red, 3 failed (a, b, b-package) and 1 passed (c control). After the restore (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), lint was rebuilt, preflight `--absent` passed, and the block was green, 4 of 4.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 153 files, 7045 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: exit 0. `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` in full: 179 passed (before the package-publish leg was added; the `-t 24957` run after it passed 4 of 4).
- Dispatch-gates at head `66e0df6213`: 66 derived, 63 run, 3 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:type-check-debt`; each exited 3, prerequisite not met: a full-workspace build). Those are declared to CI.

## Producers measured

- In-repo, at `3b3830ca22`: 0 `validations[]` predicates read `parent` across `examples/`, `packages/create-objectstack`, `skills/` and package objects. The 10 files under `examples` / `packages/create-objectstack` / `skills` that author `validations:` were grepped for `parent`. Control leg: the same grep finds the field-rule reads (`examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/invoice.object.ts`, 3 `readonlyWhen` hits), so it does reach the corpus. Nothing to fix.
- HotCRM: NOT MEASURED, because no checkout is in this container.

## Acceptance notes

- **`check:empty-changeset` is red on purpose.** This PR also edits the pending `.changeset/24720-validation-rule-parent.md`. That note said "Nothing new is refused in 18.x … The refusal … is planned for 19.0", which this PR makes false before it ships. The edit replaces that sentence with "Nothing new is refused by this change … follows in its own breaking entry (#24957)". This is the gate's DELIBERATE CORRECTION class: it stays red until a person confirms the correction. The alternative is to revert the edit and let the new entry stand alone. It is self-contained, but then the release would ship both sentences. The open Version Packages PR #24876 currently consumes that changeset.
- Open PR #24947 also edits `validate-expressions.ts`, in different hunks (imports, `StackExpressionOptions` docs, the bulk `confirmText` pass). There is no textual overlap with the verdict lines.
- The claim's file surface did not name `.changeset/24720-*.md` or the metadata-protocol door block. Both are declared here.
- Unchanged and out of scope: `current_user` / `input` / `os` / `trigger` in a `validations[]` condition (the family the card notes for triage).
